# tplinkeasysmart_lags (Data Source)

Link aggregation groups (Switching > Port Trunk). Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_lags" "this" {}

output "lags" {
  value = data.tplinkeasysmart_lags.this.lags
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `lags`.
- `lags` (Attributes List) All groups the switch supports; unused groups have no ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lags))

<a id="nestedatt--lags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Group number.
- `ports` (List of Number) Member ports.
